summary: Hyundai ABS Funding LLC, as depositor for Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-C, filed an 8-K reporting an ordinary auto-loan asset-backed securitization. The filing attaches legality and tax opinions from Mayer Brown LLP dated September 17, 2026, covering Class A-1, Class A-2-A and Class A-2-B auto loan asset-backed notes issued under a Form SF-3 shelf (File No. 333-284087) and described in a prospectus dated September 15, 2026. No price, stake, premium or termination terms are stated. This is a routine structured-finance takedown, not a special situation; watch only pool performance and note spreads.
